points.description: States that the two main stack functions are push (add an item to the top) and pop (remove an item from the top). Central idea in any wording; names push and pop (or clear equivalents like add/insert on top and remove/take off top).
points.partial_credit: Half or so (2-3 marks) if only one of push/pop is given, or both are described vaguely (e.g. add and remove) without being clearly tied to the top of the stack.

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming both push and pop, or clearly describing adding to and removing from the top of the stack, in any wording. Give part marks if only one of the two is correct or the answer is vague. Give little or none for answers about unrelated functions (e.g. enqueue/dequeue, or just peek/isEmpty) without push or pop. Extra remarks do not lose marks.
